exposure: mode of birth (vaginal birth, caesarean section)
outcome: abdominal muscle fatigue (measured by electromyographic parameters)
cohort: A pilot study comparing 11 women after vaginal birth, 8 women after caesarean section, and 8 nulliparous control women.
finding: Electromyographic parameters of abdominal muscles fatigue were similar in women after natural childbirth, women after caesarean section, and nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Abdominal muscle fatigue parameters were similar across women who had natural childbirth, caesarean section, or had not given birth, with caesarean section not impacting abdominal muscle strength in plank exercise.
